records.text: Forty-eight hours before Charlie Kirk was shot, he intended to have Candace Owens speak at his signature event despite fierce pushback.
records.speaker: John Yep

appearances.snippet: Just 48 hours before my friend Charlie Kirk was shot, in spite of the fierce pushback, he made known his intention to have Candace (Candace Owens) speak at his own signature event.

verification.notes: The event organizer later repeated that Charlie Kirk intended Candace Owens to appear 48 hours before his death, but this is an assertion about private intent and pushback with no independent contemporaneous documentation. Verification attempted; the underlying claim remains unverifiable.

records.text: Catholics for Catholics announced Candace Owens as a keynote speaker at its National Catholic Prayer for America Gala in Washington, D.C., on March 19.
records.speaker: John Yep

appearances.snippet: With this in mind, and with a nod to my friend Charlie (Charlie Kirk), Catholics for Catholics is honored to announce that Candace Owens will be joining us as one of the keynote speakers at our National Catholic Prayer for America Gala in Washington, D.C. on March 19th.

verification.notes: Transcript reports the event announcement. Catholics for Catholics officially announced Candace Owens as a keynote speaker for its March 19, 2026 Washington, D.C. gala, and later published the event video confirming she appeared.
